findings.detail: Direct lending rows with blank extracted interest_rate have stated Reference Rate and Spread values in the source table, for example GB Eagle Buyer at S + 4.50 %.
PIK-inclusive reference-rate cells are also present in the source and should populate rate fields rather than remain blank.

rationale: The dl_rate_fill flag is real. The bundle shows the extracted holdings slice for direct lending positions has blank interest_rate fields, while the raw SOI table has a dedicated Reference Rate and Spread column and matching debt rows with explicit rates, including GB Eagle Buyer, Inc. at S + 4.50 %, Titan BW Borrower L.P. at S + 5.38 % (includes 2.88 % PIK), and Seko Global Logistics Network, LLC at S + 7.00 % (includes 5.00 % PIK). This supports an extraction gap in rate population rather than a false alarm.
